data.one_liner: Dependency-free Flutter bottom sheet with spring physics and snap points.
data.what_it_does: Provides a spring-animated bottom sheet with support for content sizing, snap points, coordinated scrolling, and rubber-band drag gestures. It can be used via a modal route helper or directly as a widget.
use_when: You need a modal bottom sheet with physics-based spring animations and snap points.
You want coordinated scrolling where the sheet resizes before the inner list scrolls.
avoid_when: You require standard Material Design bottom sheet behavior without physics-based customization.
strengths: Supports content-height sizing and fractional snap points
Includes coordinated scrolling and rubber-band resistance
weaknesses: Requires a specific minimum Dart SDK version
